source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: This port selects gecko_taskgraph.transforms.filter_notarization in both ordinary and localized mac notarization kinds, directly after from_deps. The owned diff preserves dependencies, grouping, attribute copying and downstream transforms. Accepted source retains that selector; the localized signing-transform rename is a separate later phase. These files prove which external transform is selected, not its internal filtering rules or a successful notarization run.
title: The notarization port changes two kind selectors while preserving dependency order
